svg.title: Lord of the Gates of Matter: the Child of the Forces of Time: The Devil (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Above, Capricorn, the Key's attribution; below, the letter Ayin (ע); Key XV, Path 26. Its ring: number 72 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1791650460506-a39t2cu4k6d.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.

The Child of the Forces of Time
